description: Rename a workspace feed (title; null clears it) or set its sign-in for a members-only forum (auth: { type: 'cookie', value } with the Cookie header the person's signed-in browser sends, or { type: 'header', name, value }). A sign-in is checked by reading the feed with it (feed_login_expired when it does not work), stored encrypted, never shown again, and the feed is then read for this workspace alone; auth: null removes it.

value.description: The Cookie header your browser sends to the forum (devtools, Network, the feed's request, Request Headers, cookie).

name.description: The header name, e.g. Api-Key (Discourse) or Authorization.

anyOf.description: A sign-in for a members-only feed: a cookie, or one header. Write-only: stored encrypted, sent to the feed's own site alone, never shown again. A feed with a sign-in is read for this workspace alone.

auth.description: Replaces the sign-in (checked by reading the feed with it first); null removes it and the feed is read signed out again.

title.description: Your name for the feed; null clears it.

name: update_feed
title: Update feed
